_comment: Preset DiLiM Supplement — do tu video mau 'Te bao nao ton thuong...' (1080x1920@60, DaVinci Resolve). Doi cac gia tri o day de dung cho brand khac; khong sua build.py.

layout._comment_band: Do tu video mau: dai B-roll chiem 34-41% chieu cao, pho bien nhat ~38%. Canh duoi cat thang, KHONG bo goc/vien/do bong.
layout._comment_translate: A-roll giu scale 1.00, chi dich xuong 12.5% chieu cao khung (~240px) khi dai bat. Dich la step tuc thi, khong ease.

logo._comment: Badge goc tren trai, x 5-29%, y 3-8%. Luon nam TREN cung ke ca frame flash. Dat src = duong dan file PNG co alpha, hoac null de bo qua.

font._comment: Anton da kiem chung du 52/52 dau tieng Viet kho (E-mu-sac, O-moc-nga...). CANH BAO: Bebas Neue va Impact THIEU dau tieng Viet - chu se hien o vuong. Font thay the an toan: Be Vietnam Pro Black, Montserrat Black, iCiel Koni Black.

colors._comment: white/yellow/red/navy/magenta do truc tiep tu frame. green va orange la uoc luong tu mo ta dinh tinh - chinh lai neu co logo brand chuan.

caption._comment_baseline: Day khoi chu neo o ~38.5% chieu cao khung, tuc DE LEN duong seam giua B-roll va A-roll. Day la dac diem nhan dang cua format - dung bao gio ha xuong lower third.
caption._comment_size: 5.8% chieu cao khung ~ 111px, cho cap-height ~4.5% nhu do duoc tren video mau.

hook._use: 2-3 dong mo dau, cau moc cau chuyen. Video mau dung fill gradient vang->cam; ASS khong lam duoc gradient nen dung vang dam solid. Muon dung gradient that phai render PNG rieng roi overlay.

quote._use: Card trich dan / cau title cua video. Dung DUNG MOT LAN. Co dau ngoac kep magenta goc tren-trai va duoi-phai + dong attribution nho.

plate_red._use: Caption chay doan VAN DE: trieu chung, canh bao, rui ro, hau qua. Hop tu co gian om chu.

edu._use: Doan GIAI THICH / giai phap. Dong 1 trang = cau khang dinh, dong 2 vang = loi ich. Mau theo DONG, khong bao gio theo tung tu.

keyword._use: MOT tu khoa duy nhat can nho (ten hoat chat, trieu chung chinh). Giu lau 5-6s lam neo chu de, khong doi theo nhip 2s.

cta._use: Keu goi hanh dong cuoi video. Hop dac mau brand, cac dong xen ke xanh la / do, wipe hop truoc chu sau.

transitions._comment: Video mau dung 4 kieu: hard cut (nhieu nhat), slide ngang trai->phai 0.30-0.40s khi doi clip trong dai, slide len khi dai thoat, cross-dissolve 0.45s ease-out khi dai vao.

kenburns._comment: Push-in tuyen tinh neo giua, 1.00 -> 1.13 (~+6%/giay). Reset ve 1.00 moi clip moi. Co the day toi 1.5 cho clip an du can nhan manh.

endcard._comment: Hard cut + 1 frame flash trang vao end card. Nen gradient dong, vien bo goc tim. Giu tinh ~3s, KHONG fade to black.

rhythm._comment: Nguong dung cho lint_plan.py. Video mau: B-roll phu ~83% thoi luong, breather A-roll sach moi 12-15s, 1 breather dai 5s dat dung cho chuyen doan van de -> giai phap.
